name: Toolbar Cleanup for Divi
author: Jamie Dąbrowiecki

sections.description:
Every installation of Divi adds a set of buttons to the WYSIWYG (TinyMCE) toolbar in the Classic Editor. These are dated, and most users who utilise the Divi Theme Builder or Page Builder will not use these.
This simple plugin removes the “Add ET Learn More Block”, “Add ET Box”, “Add ET Button”, “Add ET Tabs”, and “Add Author Bio” buttons from the toolbar.
This plugin is compatible with all versions of Divi that have the aforementioned buttons in the TinyMCE toolbar – this includes Divi 5.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate via the Plugins menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Do I need the Divi theme active for this to work?

Yes. The plugin is designed specifically for the Divi theme and has no effect without it.

Will you add new features to this plugin?

It is highly unlikely – it is a simple, lightweight plug-and-play solution and I don’t intend to change this.
